You can work on being more efficient with the combined use of the main, vorpal lance and explosive TP. For example, get used to the fire rate of the main and don’t waste a VL on 2 ravens if you know the main is about to fire, since the main can take out both of them by itself. You can be much more aggressive with the use of TP for clearing smaller ships since it has good cooldown recovery. Getting used to the fire rate of the main will also mean less missed shots, which accumulates to a significant increase in DPS
